d.title: One Piece 3D: Mugiwara Chase
d.jp: ONE PIECE 3D 麦わらチェイス
d.synopsis: One day, as Monkey D. Luffy and his crew are journeying along the Grand Line, his treasured straw hat is snatched by an eagle. Willing to do anything to get his hat back, the pirates chase after the bird, maintaining their pursuit even when it takes them to a base belonging to the Marines.
